Work experience — VERY IMPORTANT

This is currently completely empty in the screenshot.

Fill this.

Even if some of your experience was internship/startup/project-based, put legitimate professional experience here.

For each real company:

Company: actual company name
Title: actual title
Dates: actual dates
Description: 3–4 bullets max

For example, if your startup experience was as a software/full-stack engineer, structure it around what you built, not responsibilities:

Built and shipped full-stack features across frontend, backend, database, and deployment.
Worked directly on product requirements and converted ambiguous ideas into working features.
Used Node.js, Vue/Nuxt, PostgreSQL and Docker to build and deploy production applications.

But don't copy these blindly—we should use your actual company, title, dates and actual work.
